item.description: - Paste a web address into a margin note and it becomes a small card: the page's picture, its title and its site. Press it to open that page. - If you've already highlighted that page, the card shows a coloured tick for each highlight. Press the ticks to read those passages without leaving the page you're on. - Bookmark a page and its top right corner folds over, like a dog-eared page in a book. Press the folded corner to take the bookmark off again. - The bookmark button is now a bookmark, in place of a star. - The tab you're on is shown by its title, in full black, with the other tabs' titles paler. - The colours for highlighting are now marker tips, easier to press. - A new highlight or underline appears with a gentle bloom. - Highlighting words you'd already underlined keeps the underline. - The page now always sits inside a thin white frame, across the top too once the top row has slid away, so it no longer widens and nudges the words after you scroll.
